title: ACSM Position Stand: Resistance Training (2026)
text:
To maximize muscle hypertrophy, training each muscle group 2-3 times per week is superior to 1 time per week. A dose-response relationship exists between weekly training volume and muscle growth, with 10-20 sets per muscle group per week appearing optimal for most individuals.

Hypertrophy can be achieved across a wide spectrum of loading ranges (e.g., 30% to 85% of 1RM) provided that sets are taken close to muscular failure. Heavy loads (>80% 1RM) are superior for maximizing maximal strength adaptations compared to lighter loads.

Rest intervals of at least 2 minutes between sets of multi-joint exercises promote greater hypertrophy and strength gains compared to shorter rest intervals (e.g., 60 seconds), as they allow for greater volume load to be accumulated.
